content.title: About
content.content: Baby Toddler puffs are soft, crunchy snacks specially designed for children aged 6 months to 3 years. They are made from vegetable purees (carrot, pumpkin, broccoli) and whole grains, without added sugar, salt, or artificial flavors.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The puffs are shaped like tiny clouds, making them easy for little hands to pick up.
Each serving provides up to 5 g of vegetables, helping to build a taste for veggies early on.
The product has passed dermatological and dental safety tests – safe for delicate gums.
Packaging is made from recyclable, eco‑friendly material.
Puffs dissolve quickly in the mouth, reducing choking risk for toddlers.

items.title: Rich in vitamins A and C
items.content: Vegetable purees supply vitamins that support vision and immune function.

items.title: Source of dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber promotes healthy digestion and a balanced gut microbiome.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: No added salt helps develop normal taste preferences without excess sodium.

items.title: Gluten‑ and lactose‑free
items.content: Suitable for children with gluten or lactose intolerance.

items.title: Supports chewing skill development
items.content: The gentle texture encourages development of oral motor skills.

items.title: Allergy to ingredients
items.content: Although formulated to be hypoallergenic, children with known vegetable allergies should be consulted with a pediatrician.

items.title: Shelf life after opening
items.content: Once opened, consume within 7 days and keep in a dry place.

items.title: Not a meal replacement
items.content: Puffs are intended as a snack supplement, not a primary source of nutrition.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve straight from the pack, allowing the child to pick up the puffs. If needed, lightly moisten with water for infants just starting on solid foods.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight. After opening, reseal tightly to prevent moisture absorption.
